definitions.explanation: The gradual loss of the eye's ability to focus on nearby objects, typically occurring around age 40 and older.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧、{老眼|ろうがん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{小|ちい}さい→小さい：00025_chiisai⟧⟦{字|じ}→字：01606_ji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{読|よ}み→読む：00426_yomu⟧⟦にくく→にくい：02005_nikui⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Lately, I've had trouble reading small print due to presbyopia.

examples.japanese: 40⟦{歳|さい}→歳：10017_sai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{過|す}ぎる→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{老眼|ろうがん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まる→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
⟦{老眼鏡|ろうがんきょう}→老眼鏡：19227_rougankyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かけて→かける：00854_kakeru⟧⟦{新聞|しんぶん}→新聞：01440_shinbun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
examples.english: I wear reading glasses to read the newspaper.

notes:
USAGE: {老眼|ろうがん} is a natural age-related condition affecting nearly everyone eventually. It's distinct from other vision problems.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {老眼|ろうがん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to develop presbyopia)
- {老眼|ろうがん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧ (presbyopia progresses)
- ⟦{老眼鏡|ろうがんきょう}→老眼鏡：19227_rougankyou⟧ (reading glasses)
- {老眼|ろうがん}⟦{用|よう}→用：09842_you⟧⟦レンズ→レンズ：07808_renzu⟧ (lenses for presbyopia)

OTHER VISION CONDITIONS:
- ⟦{近視|きんし}→近視：02683_kinshi⟧ - nearsightedness (myopia)
- ⟦{遠視|えんし}→遠視：07105_enshi⟧ - farsightedness (hyperopia) - not age-related
- ⟦{乱視|らんし}→乱視：06370_ranshi⟧ - astigmatism

NOTE ON TERMINOLOGY: {老眼|ろうがん} is sometimes translated as "farsightedness," but technically it's presbyopia (aging-related), while ⟦{遠視|えんし}→遠視：07105_enshi⟧ is hyperopia (can occur at any age).
